gain_rule: Median latest observed Day 0-30 EPSS from training CVEs only, bounded to [0.001, 0.05]. No targets or validation inputs.
selection: Earliest strictly best validation MAE from epoch 1. No epoch-zero selection. All fixed seeds reported.
reference: Repeat the latest observed Day 0-30 EPSS, in the same float32 representation as the model persistence connection.
limitations: Descriptions and summaries are retrospective, not authenticated Day-30 snapshots.
Stored SMP date screening does not prove historical publication or content availability.
Distinct CVE IDs are not proof of independent vulnerability families or evidence.
The graph cache preserves chunks and typed security edges but does not prove semantic correctness.
Validation has informed development. This is not independent final test evaluation.
The Day-90 learned branches collapsed. This matched endpoint experiment retains their settings, not a proposed fix.
Partial histories are retained; observed Day-60 targets are never imputed.
Smoke metrics test integration only; they do not select seeds or settings.
